brief:
Hamas chief Khalil Al-Hayya said Thursday the group was not prepared to withstand continued Israeli attacks, Al-Monitor reported. Local medics said Israeli strikes killed at least 10 people in Gaza, though details of the casualties remained incomplete in the initial account.

The statement from Al-Hayya marked a significant moment in the conflict's escalation, suggesting Hamas leadership was reassessing its operational posture amid the ongoing strikes.

title: Hamas weighs response after Israeli strikes kill 10 in Gaza
